analysis: The failure occurs in the test teardown ('after each' hook) while removing a temp workspace directory on Windows, with EBUSY indicating the directory was still held open by another process (e.g. VS Code, a file watcher, or a lingering child process) when cleanup ran. This is a classic Windows file-locking race condition unrelated to test assertions or application logic. The PR only touches src/Aspire.Cli/Projects/DotNetAppHostProject.cs and CLI launch-profile tests; it does not modify the VS Code extension E2E test fixtures or the dynamic debug configuration test/workspace teardown code, so the failure is not attributable to the PR's changes.
